semiconductor_relevance: High — HangZhou ShuNan specializes in semiconductor process technology services and provides essential equipment and consumables for manufacturing.
summary: HangZhou ShuNan Automation Technology Co., Ltd. offers high-precision consumables and intelligent equipment tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their product line includes film peeling tape, dicing rings, and fully automatic film applicators, aimed at enhancing manufacturing efficiency and quality.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Hangzhou, focusing on the domestic semiconductor market while also aiming for global outreach.
